rules: Product is the canonical catalog identity.
Offer is the canonical commercial availability record.
Offer references Product and does not own Product identity.
Offer ownership resolves to Organization plus AFX-CORE authorization context.
Inventory does not redefine Product identity.
Order history snapshots required commercial state and is not rewritten by catalog edits.
Experience accesses Product and Offer only through the canonical API.
Private cross-domain database access is forbidden.
